From: Joy Okafor <j.okafor@lindenelementary.example>
To: Fourth grade families
Date: Tuesday 10 November 2026, 07:40
Subject: Fourth grade trip to the science museum, Thursday 19 November

Dear families,

Our fourth graders will visit the science museum on Thursday 19 November,
leaving school at 9:00 and returning by 2:30. Please return the signed
permission form and the 12 dollar fee by Friday 13 November.

We still need two parent chaperones. If you can come, please reply to this
email and let me know.

Thank you!
Ms. Okafor
